```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
#DF <- read.csv("/Users/mari/Desktop/mitox/data/modelling_AE-with-mics_baseline.csv")
DF <- read.csv("../data/modelling_AE-with-mics_baseline.csv")
```

# check adjusted p-value
# decide to use normal p-value since adjusted are all equal to 1
```{r}
p <- DF$p.value
p.adjust(p, method = "bonferroni")
```

# log estimate value to handle outliers
```{r}
DF <-DF %>%
  mutate(new.estimate = ifelse(estimate > 0, log(estimate), log(abs(estimate))*-1))
```

# Create label
```{r}
# filter labels to p.value < 0.06
DF <- DF %>%
  mutate(taxa = ifelse(p.value < 0.1 & (new.estimate < -1.5 | new.estimate > 1.5), sub("^.+\\.", "", term), NA))
```

```{r}
DF <- DF %>%
  mutate(level = substr(taxa, 1,1),
         'Taxonmic Level' = ifelse(level == "k", "Kingdom", 
                        ifelse(level == "p", "Phylum",
                               ifelse(level == "c", "Class", 
                                      ifelse(level == "o", "Order",
                                             ifelse(level == "f", "Family",
                                                    ifelse(level == "g", "Genus",
                                                           ifelse(level == "s", "Species",
                                                                  level))))))))
```

```{r}
DF_color <- DF %>% filter(!is.na(level))
```


# plot
```{r}
ggplot(data = DF, aes(x = new.estimate, y = -log10(p.value), label=taxa)) + 
  geom_point(color="honeydew4") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(x="log(estimate)") + 
  geom_text_repel() +
  geom_point(data = DF_color, aes(x = new.estimate, y = -log10(p.value), label=taxa, color=`Taxonmic Level`))+
geom_vline(xintercept=c(-1.5, 1.5), linetype="dotted") +
geom_hline(yintercept=0.99, linetype="dotted")
ggsave("../figures/mitoxvolcanoplot.png",device = "png",height=5,width = 7,dpi=400)
```
